summary: Frontend-only test of the Laboratorio refactor (mobile 430x920, lang=it, profile=pro). Verified: 4-tab bottom nav, 'Scienza & Guide' -> Accademia, giant CTA -> Generatore di Ricette, Pro/Passione toggle from ☰ menu, and the Generatore di Piano 3-tab bar. CRITICAL FAILURE: the capo tabs 'Parametri IA' and 'Genera & Salva' render EMPTY (their content is nested inside the still-open produci wrapper), so [data-testid=capo-generate] and [data-testid=capo-advanced-title] are never visible -> the planner Generate button is unreachable (regression).

ui_bugs.issue:
JSX nesting bug: the wrapper
opened at line 953 is NEVER closed at line 1022 — line 1022's
closes the
opened at line 1002. Consequence: the 'parametri' wrapper (line 1023), the 'produci||genera' wrapper (line 1235) and the 'genera' wrapper (line 1565) are all CHILDREN of the produci wrapper. DOM proof (x-line-number attrs): capo-generate -> div@1565 -> Section -> div@1235 -> div@953 (display:none) when planTab='genera'. Measured: produci tab -> plan-switch=True, advanced-title=False, generate=False; genera tab -> ALL False; parametri tab -> ALL False. Tabs 2 and 3 show a blank screen below the sticky tab bar.
Native browser <select> used for 'PRE-FERMENTO / LIEVITAZIONE' (and other dropdowns) instead of the shadcn Select — inconsistent with the dark/orange design system on mobile.

Menu stays open after choosing Pro/Passione and does not close on Escape; the full-screen overlay [data-testid=site-menu] (fixed inset-0 z-[300]) then intercepts pointer events on the bottom nav until [data-testid=site-menu-close] is clicked. Minor UX/testability friction.

integration_issues.flow: Planner: Cosa Produci -> Genera & Salva (critical regression check)
integration_issues.issue: Cannot complete: after entering a quantity and switching to 'Genera & Salva', [data-testid=capo-generate] is present in the DOM but display:none via the un-closed produci wrapper (bounding_box = None), so the Genera button is not clickable. No JS crash / no white page, but the flow is functionally blocked.

critical_code_review_comments: PianoProduzioneAI.jsx is 1833 lines with manually managed 'hidden' wrapper divs — the unbalanced wrapper at line 953 is exactly the failure mode this pattern invites. Extract each tab into its own component (<TabProduci/>, <TabParametri/>, <TabGenera/>) and render conditionally.
goPlanTab() calls scrollIntoView on a selector that may be display:none; add a guard/assert so a hidden target surfaces as a bug instead of a silent no-op.

rca_of_the_issue:
In /app/frontend/src/sections/PianoProduzioneAI.jsx the tab wrapper opened at line 953 (planTab==='produci') is not closed: line 1022's pairs with the
opened at line 1002. Therefore every subsequent tab wrapper (1023 parametri, 1235 produci||genera, 1565 genera) is a descendant of the produci wrapper and inherits display:none whenever planTab !== 'produci'. Verified in the live DOM via the x-line-number attributes on the ancestor chain of [data-testid=capo-generate]. Fix = add the missing
